title: A Lizard Can Run Across Water for 15 Feet

scenes.text: A lizard can run across water for 15 feet.
It's the basilisk, nicknamed the Jesus Christ lizard.
It runs on its hind legs at about five feet a second.
Each step slaps down and makes a small pocket of air around the foot, so it never sinks more than a few inches.
A human would need to run 65 miles an hour to do the same, says David Attenborough.
After about 15 feet, it drops to all fours and swims away.

description:
A basilisk lizard can run across water for about 15 feet.
It runs on its hind legs at about five feet a second, and air pockets around its feet hold it up.
Then it drops down and swims.
Which animal would you most like to copy?
first_comment: Which animal superpower would you pick: running on water or flying?
